titulo: Going back to say the tip worked
caption:
Going back to say the tip worked

"I tried the ramen." "And?" "Best bowl in months." Weeks after the tip, she went back to tell him.

People rarely learn whether their tip worked, so telling them is a gift that costs one sentence.

For whoever tells them the tip was good.

Choose friction.
